name: push_once
description: Push one explicit Git ref after user confirmation in the Agent Watch macOS window (independent of client approval mode). An ordinary branch deletion takes one click. Deleting a protected branch takes one click followed by typing the repository name. Other operations confirm any risks separately and require the repository name. Other platforms or an explicit --client-forms server configuration use client MCP forms. Include a short reason in the user's language; it is context, never an approval. The tool waits for the person and executes the push itself. After refusal, show manual_command; never execute it or retry automatically. Never answer or automate confirmation windows or forms.

destination.description: One full refs/heads/ or refs/tags/ ref.

source.description: Revision to freeze; default HEAD. Omit for deletes.

delete.description: Request deletion of the destination ref.

reason.description: One short sentence in the user's language explaining why this change is needed. Do not claim approval or tell the user what to select.

title: Подтвердить изменение репозитория
